# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/pdm
# args: 
Usage: pdm venv [-h] [-p PROJECT_PATH] [--path PATH | --python PYTHON] ...

Virtualenv management

Options:
  -h, --help            Show this help message and exit.
  -p PROJECT_PATH, --project PROJECT_PATH
                        Specify another path as the project root, which
                        changes the base of pyproject.toml and __pypackages__
                        [env var: PDM_PROJECT]
  --path PATH           Show the path to the given virtualenv
  --python PYTHON       Show the python interpreter path for the given
                        virtualenv

Commands:
  create                Create a virtualenv
  list                  List all virtualenvs associated with this project
  remove                Remove the virtualenv with the given name
  activate              Print the command to activate the virtualenv with the
                        given name
  purge                 Purge selected/all created Virtualenvs
